display.purpose: Page titles (h1) only. Fixed 30px bold, tracking-tight. Never fluid.

title.purpose: Section-card and dialog headers; semibold at body size.

body.purpose: Default UI text, labels, inputs, table cells, card copy.

label.purpose: Table column headers and micro-labels. UPPERCASE tracked — the only earned uppercase.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default for color/background state changes on buttons, nav items, inputs.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary commit action — Lunas Blue fill, white label, 44px tall.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:44px; padding:0 14px; border:none; border-radius:8px; background:#007BFF; color:#FFFFFF; font-family:Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#005ABB; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,123,255,.2); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background:#BDBDBD; opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: The default secondary action — transparent fill, 2px Lunas Blue border, blue label.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:44px; padding:0 14px; border:2px solid #007BFF; border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:#007BFF; font-family:Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:rgba(0,123,255,.1); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,123,255,.2); } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { border-color:#BDBDBD; color:#BDBDBD; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Input (with Rp add-on)
components.description: Labeled field with optional inline money/rate add-on; blue focus ring, Mist border at rest.
components.html: Rp
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; font-family:Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif; max-width:320px; } .ds-field-label { font-size:1rem; color:#0D0E0E; } .ds-input { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; height:44px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid #D9DADA; border-radius:8px; background:#FFFFFF; transition:border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-input:focus-within { border-color:#007BFF; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,123,255,.2); } .ds-input-addon { flex-shrink:0; color:#323636; font-size:1rem; } .ds-input-el { flex:1; min-width:0; border:none; outline:none; background:transparent; font-family:inherit; font-size:1rem; color:#0D0E0E; } .ds-input-el::placeholder { color:#BDBDBD; }

components.name: Status Chip (Success)
components.description: Financial state badge — pale tint background, deep-tone label, always paired with a word.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; border-radius:4px; padding:4px 10px; font-family:Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.75rem; font-weight:500; line-height:1; } .ds-chip-success { background:#F6FEF9; color:#067647; } .ds-chip-warning { background:#FFFCF5; color:#B54708; } .ds-chip-error { background:#FFFBFA; color:#B42318; }

components.name: Navigation Item (Selected)
components.description: Sidebar row — Charcoal at rest, Lunas Blue tint + label when selected or hovered.
components.html: Penjualan
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; width:240px; padding:12px; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:#323636; font-family:Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s, color .2s; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:rgba(0,123,255,.2); color:#007BFF; } .ds-nav-item--selected { background:rgba(0,123,255,.1); color:#007BFF; }

components.name: Currency Display
components.description: Signature money component — Indonesian-formatted rupiah, Rp prefix and dot thousand separators.
components.css: .ds-currency { font-family:Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1.5rem; font-weight:700; color:#0D0E0E; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; letter-spacing:-0.01em; }

narrative.overview: Loonas is bookkeeping made calm. The surface behaves like a well-kept ledger: every figure is legible and in its place, the page breathes with whitespace, and a single blue signal does all the pointing. An owner runs payments, invoicing, POS, stock, and the books out of one app — so the system's first job is to make twelve modules feel like one quiet, dependable product. The reference points are Mekari and Xero: blue-accented, generous with whitespace, clean cards and tables, data you never have to squint at. White cards sit on a near-white surface, divided by hairline borders, never by drop shadows or glass.
keyCharacteristics: One quiet voice: Lunas Blue (#007BFF) is the only saturated color on most screens, reserved for action, selection, and 'pay attention.'
Flat by construction: depth is carried by 1px borders and tonal layering, never shadows.
A single typographic family (Manrope) tuned across a fixed rem scale — no fluid display type.
Money legibility is non-negotiable: Indonesian-formatted figures (Rp 1.250.000), always clear.
A 44px control rhythm (h-11) across every interactive element for calm vertical cadence and touch comfort.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Lunas Blue is the only saturated accent on a standard screen, and it never decorates — it marks the primary action, the current selection, or a focus ring. If two things on a screen are blue 'for emphasis,' one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Tint-and-Deep Rule
rules.body: Financial status is always a pale-50 background under a -500 deep-tone label. Never a full-saturation -300 fill behind white text.

rules.name: The Color-Is-Never-Alone Rule
rules.body: Status must pair color with an icon or word. Red alone does not mean 'overdue' for a colorblind owner — the label does.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Product type is sized in fixed rem, never clamp(). A heading that shrinks inside a sidebar looks broken, not responsive.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Manrope carries everything. Reaching for a second typeface to 'add personality' is forbidden — personality here is restraint.

rules.name: The Border-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate with a 1px Mist (#D9DADA) border, never a box-shadow. If a card needs a drop shadow to read, the layout has failed.

rules.name: The Ring-On-Focus-Only Rule
rules.body: The blue focus ring is the system's sole glow. It appears on focus and nowhere else — no resting glows, no hover shadows, no ambient blur.

dos: Do keep Lunas Blue (#007BFF) as the single saturated accent — primary action, current selection, focus ring.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px Mist (#D9DADA) border on white-over-#FAFAFA; let tonal layering carry depth.
Do size every interactive control at 44px tall (h-11) and round it to 8px (rounded-lg).
Do render every rupiah value through CurrencyDisplay / NumberDisplay so it always reads Rp 1.250.000.
Do back financial status with a pale-50 tint under a deep-500 label, and always pair color with a word or icon.
Do keep Manrope as the only typeface, sized in fixed rem across the whole hierarchy.
donts: Don't ship generic templated SaaS — cream/gray dashboards, identical icon-heading-text card grids, or hero-metric tiles with gradient accents.
Don't drift toward loud crypto/neon fintech: no dark-mode gradients, glassmorphism, glow, or decorative blur.
Don't rebuild a cluttered legacy ERP — no walls of fields with no hierarchy; progressive disclosure over density-for-its-own-sake.
Don't go consumer-toy: no oversized radii, emoji, bouncy/elastic motion, or pastel-everything.
Don't add a box-shadow to a card to make it read — fix the layout instead.
Don't use text-gray-* classes or invent a bg-primary-default token — use the neutral-* ramp and real primary-* steps.
Don't use clamp()/fluid type for product headings, and never use UPPERCASE tracked text as a section eyebrow.
Don't put a second saturated color next to Lunas Blue for emphasis, or use a full-saturation -300 fill behind white text for a status chip.
